Built a complete, self-contained browser game in `index.html`: **Morrowmere — The Catlight**. Explore an abandoned village as a skeleton in a blue nightgown, find and befriend all eight cats, and finish the adventure.

It includes keyboard and touch joystick controls, a responsive phone/tablet layout, pause and restart options, and a hand-drawn canvas world. I checked the start screen and gameplay in the browser.

To play, serve the workspace with `python3 -m http.server 3002` and open `http://localhost:3002`. Assumption: a lightweight, no-dependency browser game best fits the 2D mobile/tablet request.
